description: 《欺骗古鲁菲》中追逐太阳的狼。
fullDescription: Sköll的核心身份是追逐太阳的狼。来源没有要求它穿甲、燃烧、长角或长成芬里尔的复制品。卡图应通过速度、追逐方向、太阳目标与独特狼形轮廓表现神话性。
roleInSeries: 把世界终局的压力提前埋入日常太阳运行。
visualThesis: 自然狼科基础之上的神话追猎者，身形偏修长、向上追逐，太阳远处作为目标；神话性来自尺度、速度和天穹关系而非装甲。

interpretationNotes: 毛色、体型细节与超自然特征未被来源固定
与Hati的体型/姿态差异属于系列视觉设计
canon.worldState: 天穹秩序运行中，末日尚未来临。

instructions: 与Hati：Sköll更修长、向上冲刺、暖光目标；Hati用不同体型和横向/月夜构图

visual.detailHierarchy: 眼、狼头、前躯高细节；太阳和云低细节。
visual.subjectSeparation: 狼头锐利，背景云层软化，暖太阳远离主体。

Content brief: Create Sköll as the wolf pursuing the sun through the ordered sky. Use believable natural wolf anatomy with mythic scale and extreme chase energy, not armor, horns, flames or a generic game boss. Make him visually distinct from Hati: leaner silhouette, upward sprinting trajectory, warm distant sun as the target. The sun remains distant; do not show it already devoured. Keep the head and ears safely inside crop margins. Restrained sky, low-detail clouds, subject-first painterly illustration.

Visual thesis: 自然狼科基础之上的神话追猎者，身形偏修长、向上追逐，太阳远处作为目标；神话性来自尺度、速度和天穹关系而非装甲。

Identity anchors: 狼形；追逐太阳；高速向上运动；太阳为远目标

Must keep: 自然狼 anatomy；不遮挡头部；不做Fenrir复制

Must avoid: 装甲狼；火焰狼；恶魔角；Fenrir复制；游戏Boss；太阳吞噬已发生

Composition: camera low angle; shot upward sprinting three-quarter; keep the primary subject/action inside the crop-safe upper-middle area.

Match the established M01 artwork family: painterly mythic realism with matte surfaces, broad readable shapes, controlled cinematic blue-white frost and restrained ember light, atmospheric depth, limited focal sharpness, and restrained brush detail. Subject or key moment must be sharper and more contrasted than the background. Use mythology-first visual storytelling rather than generic AI fantasy. Keep at most one primary environmental motif and one secondary motif; preserve quiet areas and clear visual hierarchy. Compose for future card crop safety: the face, hands, identity symbol, key object, or story action must work in the upper-middle area; the bottom 30 percent may be sacrificed.

Color and material guidance: palette 铁灰；暗棕；太阳金；云灰; materials 毛发；风；云；太阳光; mood predatory；fast；solar-chase；mythic-natural.

Related card IDs for narrative continuity only: 1003010012；1003010015. Preserve their mythic relationship without cloning faces, silhouettes, or poses.

Avoid these failure modes: armor；horns；fire wolf；Fenrir clone；game boss；sun already swallowed；Hati duplicate；typography；glossy game-CG; excessive particles, floating debris overload, glossy game-CG, hyper-detailed-everything, random glowing runes, generic Viking cosplay, modern copyrighted adaptation, malformed anatomy, extra limbs, unreadable hands or props.

Fill one complete portrait 9:16 canvas with no margins. Target final canvas at least 1620x2880 pixels.
